A no-start probe found existing Sysplorer port 49152 without starting a process, but session_manager(action=health) then started a new Sysplorer/MWORKS process and new dedicated port 49153 instead of binding to the already visible Sysplorer session. R1/R2 must not use this route for live load_file/check_model/simulate until an attach-only or no-start health route is proven.

routing_decision.reason: The current MCP session_manager health route cannot prove reuse of an existing session and demonstrably creates duplicate MWORKS/Sysplorer sessions.

serialization_rules.detail: Exactly one existing MWORKS/Sysplorer GUI/MCP session may be used for future live audit; no parallel R1/R2 sessions.
R1 owns Dynamics check_model/simulation gates; R2 waits or limits itself to static/browser planning for Dynamics.
R2 owns package-browser visibility, diagram screenshot, connection/layout readability observations, and issue list; not controller performance.
Phase A package-browser root expand, Phase B controller category browser/topology, Phase C planning/system/trace diagram screenshots, Phase D issue triage and next task packets.
Any layout repair or Smart Layout writeback must be a separate explicit source-edit/live task after screenshots identify the issue.
Stop if session_manager starts a new window/port, if process/window count drifts unexpectedly, or if license/login/gui-error evidence appears.

live_execution_phases.output: one or more package-browser screenshots plus tree observations for root categories
category visibility, representative Sysblock/topology screenshot if available, no behavior claim
planning display/map, system complete graphical, and trace-isolation wiring screenshots/observations
separate repair/check_model/smart-layout task packets only if evidence demands them

manual_review_or_blocker_triggers: Existing-session attach route cannot be proven without startup.
Package/browser tree cannot expose the selected formal candidate.
Diagram opens as blank/empty/white proxy surface or unreadable layout requiring foreground PMO/user review.
A check_model failure appears before visual acceptance; preserve evidence and return blocker/issue list instead of editing in the audit task.
